snippet.title: Survive the winter. Build everything. — Survival Game | First Teaser 🐺❄️
snippet.description:
The first look at our upcoming survival game.

You arrive with nothing in an unforgiving wilderness — and your first winter is coming. Hunt, farm and ration your food. Hold back the cold. Build, power and defend a base that can actually keep you alive. And you won't face it alone: somewhere out there is a dog that will fight the wild at your side.

  Survival systems in development:
  🔥  Manage hunger, warmth & the brutal cold of winter
  🏚️  Build, fortify and expand your base
  ⚡  Generate your own power — solar, batteries & hand-laid cables
  💧  Secure water — pumps, hoses, sprinklers & automation
  🌾  Farm and cook to outlast the seasons
  🐺  Survive wolf attacks and lethal winter nights
  🐕  Find your dog, earn its trust, and survive together

  This is an early teaser — everything shown is in active development.
